The baseline connected scene stack used 168 bytes and reserved 208 bytes. Sampled outer-active free heap was 14,320 bytes. The preview is unchanged, and a full source-only same-console rebuild is unproven. Coordinator authorship is confirmed. Latest local coding failed, with zero new weight updates. Earlier base and adapter scores were 0/4 each.

Paragraph2:give baseline connected scene stack used/reserved and sampled outer-active free heap(not globalminimum),say preview unchanged and full source-only same-console rebuild unproven,then coordinator authorship,latest local coding failures,zero new weightupdates and earlier base/adapter0of4each. All supplied stack and free-heap counts are bytes,not slots or words. Say bytes explicitly. The pose difference is observed alongside the pixel mismatch;do not say it caused the mismatch because causality is unresolved. Scene returns are not display returns. Use native_display_returns explicitly;combine record/display if equal. Do not substitute newer pending counters for baseline counters. Omit optional prefix/prologue history from the default brief. Do not claim isolated rendering cause,speed gain,whole-game/console completion,nativeChat rendering or useful training gain. You did not execute the supplied tests.
